segments.title: Your Galaxy can flag snooping apps
segments.say: Your Samsung Galaxy can now warn you when an app grabs permissions in the background.

segments.title: It's called Privacy Alerts
segments.say: It's called Privacy Alerts. On-device AI flags permissions an app doesn't need.

segments.title: Security Brief warns you too
segments.say: Security Brief also warns about malware, unknown-source apps and unneeded permissions.

segments.title: Which Galaxy phones?
segments.say: It's on the Galaxy S twenty three to S twenty six, Fold five and Flip five or newer, and some tablets.

segments.title: Not perfect
segments.sub: Samsung: alerts may miss things · **Not tested by us**
